# Tool reference

sourcebolt exposes 31 tools with `--tools all`, 30 by default and 8 with `--tools minimal`. The `batch` tools are opt-in: they are listed only under `--tools all`. Tools are grouped by name prefix.

Every tool returns structured JSON. A failure comes back as a JSON error envelope with a stable error kind.

## account

### `account_settings`

Profiles: default, all.

Read the account's quota windows, or set the output language when output_language is given. The language setting slot is not live-verified (the call is sent, but Google may ignore or reject it).

Annotations: title: Account settings, readOnly: false, destructive: false, idempotent: true, openWorld: false.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_language` | string | no | language code to set, for example en or de; omit to only read |

## auth

### `auth_login`

Profiles: default, all.

Not available through MCP: sign-in needs the local credential store, and cookies should not pass through a chat. Returns UNSUPPORTED_BY_TRANSPORT with the CLI command to run instead (sourcebolt login --import, --browser or --attach).

Annotations: title: Sign in, readOnly: false, destructive: false, idempotent: false, openWorld: false.

| `method` | string | yes | import (cookies or file), browser or attach |
| `file` | string | no | path of a cookie export file (method import) |
| `host` | string | no | NotebookLM host, for example notebook.google.com |
| `profile` | string | no | account profile name |

### `auth_logout`

Profiles: default, all.

Not available through MCP: the credential store is only reachable from the CLI. Returns UNSUPPORTED_BY_TRANSPORT with the command to run instead (sourcebolt logout).

Annotations: title: Sign out, readOnly: false, destructive: true, idempotent: true, openWorld: false.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |

| `confirm` | boolean | no | must be true to delete the stored session |

## chat

### `chat_ask`

Profiles: minimal, default, all.

Ask a question about a notebook's sources. Streams partial text as progress notifications. Returns the answer, citations (source, cited text, UTF-16 offsets) and the conversation id. wait=false returns a job_id; poll with chat_status. Not retried after sending.

Annotations: title: Ask a notebook, readOnly: false, destructive: false, idempotent: false, openWorld: false.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `notebook` | string | yes | notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title |
| `question` | string | yes | the question to ask |
| `conversation_id` | string | no | continue this conversation; default is the notebook's newest thread |
| `new_conversation` | boolean | no | start a fresh conversation instead of the default thread |
| `sources` | null or array | no | restrict the answer to these sources (id, id prefix or title); default all sources |
| `wait` | null or boolean | no | wait for the answer (default true); false returns a job_id to poll with chat_status |

### `chat_ask_many`

Profiles: batch, all.

Ask the same question in several notebooks (their default conversation thread), at most max_parallel at a time (default 3). Returns one answer with citations per notebook; a notebook that fails does not fail the others. Opt-in tool (batch group). tag is not available yet.

Annotations: title: Ask many notebooks, readOnly: false, destructive: false, idempotent: false, openWorld: false.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `question` | string | yes | the question to ask every notebook |
| `max_parallel` | integer | no | notebooks asked at once (default 3, max 10) |
| `notebooks` | null or array | no | notebook ids, id prefixes or titles |
| `tag` | string | no | not available yet: local tags are not implemented |

### `chat_configure`

Profiles: default, all.

Change a notebook's chat settings: mode (default, learning_guide, concise, detailed, custom with custom_prompt) and response_length. Unset fields keep their value. concise and detailed set response_length shorter and longer.

Annotations: title: Configure chat, readOnly: false, destructive: false, idempotent: true, openWorld: false.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `notebook` | string | yes | notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title |
| `custom_prompt` | string | no | instructions for mode custom, up to 10000 characters |
| `mode` | string | no | default, learning_guide, concise, detailed or custom (custom needs custom_prompt) |
| `response_length` | string | no | default, longer or shorter |

### `chat_history`

Profiles: default, all.

Read a notebook conversation (oldest turn first within a page), with cursor paging. format=markdown adds a rendered transcript. Turn layout is not yet live-verified.

Annotations: title: Chat history, readOnly: true, idempotent: true, openWorld: false.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `notebook` | string | yes | notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title |
| `conversation_id` | string | no | conversation to read; default is the newest thread |
| `cursor` | string | no | next_cursor of the previous page (older turns) |
| `format` | string | no | json (default) or markdown |
| `limit` | integer | no | max turns per page (default 20) |

### `chat_status`

Profiles: default, all.

Status and result of a detached chat_ask (wait=false): running, done, failed or cancelled. Jobs live in memory and are dropped an hour after they finish or when the server restarts.

Annotations: title: Chat job status, readOnly: true, idempotent: true, openWorld: false.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `job_id` | string | yes | job id returned by chat_ask with wait=false |

## delete

### `delete`

Profiles: default, all.

Delete notebooks, sources, notes, artifacts, chat history, labels or collections. Without confirm:true it only returns a preview of what would be deleted and changes nothing. Items are matched strictly (exact id, unique id prefix or exact title) against a fresh list. source, note and chat_history need notebook; chat_history deletes the whole history of the given conversations. Kinds artifact, label and collection are not available yet and return UNSUPPORTED_BY_TRANSPORT.

Annotations: title: Delete, readOnly: false, destructive: true, idempotent: true, openWorld: false.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ids` | null or array | yes | ids (or exact titles) of the items to delete; for chat_history, conversation ids |
| `kind` | string | yes | notebook, source, note, artifact, chat_history, label or collection |
| `confirm` | boolean | no | must be true to delete; without it only a preview is returned |
| `notebook` | string | no | notebook id, prefix or title; required for every kind except notebook |

## notebook

### `notebook_create`

Profiles: default, all.

Create a notebook with a title and optionally add sources in the same call (same items as source_add). The create call is sent once and never retried. emoji is accepted but ignored (no known wire slot). If the rename or the source add fails, the notebook still exists and its id is returned with warnings.

Annotations: title: Create notebook, readOnly: false, destructive: false, idempotent: false, openWorld: true.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | yes | title of the new notebook |
| `emoji` | string | no | notebook emoji (ignored: no known wire slot yet) |
| `sources` | null or array | no | sources to add right after creation; same items as source_add |

### `notebook_list`

Profiles: minimal, default, all.

List NotebookLM notebooks with id, title, source count and ownership. Filter by title and scope. Cached 30 s.

Annotations: title: List notebooks, readOnly: true, idempotent: true, openWorld: false.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | max notebooks to return (default 50) |
| `offset` | integer | no | skip this many notebooks |
| `query` | string | no | case-insensitive filter on notebook titles |
| `refresh` | boolean | no | bypass the 30 s cache |
| `scope` | string | no | mine, shared or all (default all) |

### `notebook_open`

Profiles: minimal, default, all.

Open one notebook by id or title: its sources with status, summary and suggested questions.

Annotations: title: Open notebook, readOnly: true, idempotent: true, openWorld: false.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `notebook` | string | yes | notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title |

### `notebook_update`

Profiles: default, all.

Rename a notebook (title, verified by read-back) and/or drop it from the recently viewed list (remove_from_recent). emoji, pinned, alias and tags are not available yet and are ignored with a note.

Annotations: title: Update notebook, readOnly: false, destructive: false, idempotent: true, openWorld: false.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `notebook` | string | yes | notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title |

## research

### `research_import`

Profiles: default, all.

Import research candidates as notebook sources, by urls (from research_status), report, or all. Candidates are matched by URL against a fresh read, so results reordered since research_status still import the intended ones; an unknown URL is NOT_FOUND. Candidates already in the notebook are skipped, so a retry is safe. Reports added, skipped and failed per candidate.

Annotations: title: Import research, readOnly: false, destructive: false, idempotent: false, openWorld: false.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `job` | string | yes | research job id from research_start or research_status |
| `notebook` | string | yes | notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title |
| `all` | boolean | no | import every candidate |
| `report` | boolean | no | also import the deep-research report candidate |
| `urls` | null or array | no | URLs of the web candidates to import, as listed by research_status |

### `research_start`

Profiles: default, all.

Start a web or Drive research job in a notebook (fast or deep). Returns a job handle; poll with research_status, then import with research_import. Queries under 4 words are rejected unless force is true. Mode discover is not yet available (UNSUPPORTED_BY_TRANSPORT).

Annotations: title: Start research, readOnly: false, destructive: false, idempotent: false, openWorld: true.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `notebook` | string | yes | notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title |
| `query` | string | yes | what to research; at least 4 words unless force is set |
| `corpus` | string | no | web (default) or drive; deep supports web only |
| `force` | boolean | no | allow a query shorter than 4 words |
| `mode` | string | no | fast (default) or deep; discover is not yet available |

### `research_status`

Profiles: default, all.

Check research jobs of a notebook and list their candidates (pick them by url in research_import). With wait_seconds (0-120) polls every 3 s, reporting progress, until the job is done.

Annotations: title: Research status, readOnly: true, idempotent: true, openWorld: false.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `notebook` | string | yes | notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title |
| `include_report` | boolean | no | include the deep-research report text |
| `job` | string | no | research job id; omit for all jobs of the notebook |
| `wait_seconds` | integer | no | 0-120: poll every 3 s until the job is done or time runs out |

## share

### `share_status`

Profiles: default, all.

Show who a notebook is shared with and whether the link is public.

Annotations: title: Share status, readOnly: true, idempotent: true, openWorld: false.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `notebook` | string | yes | notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title |

### `share_update`

Profiles: default, all.

Change notebook sharing: link visibility (public) and per-user roles (viewer, editor, remove). Widening access or removing people requires confirm:true; without it a preview is returned and nothing is sent. The link setting and the user changes are sent as two calls; if only one applies, status is partial and parts says which applied and which failed. Payload shapes are not live-verified. view_level and artifact sharing are not available yet.

Annotations: title: Update sharing, readOnly: false, destructive: true, idempotent: true, openWorld: true.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `notebook` | string | yes | notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title |
| `artifact` | string | no | share one artifact instead of the notebook (not available yet) |
| `confirm` | boolean | no | required to widen access or remove people; without it only a preview is returned |
| `message` | string | no | message to include in the notification |
| `notify` | boolean | no | email the added people |
| `public` | null or boolean | no | true = anyone with the link can view, false = restricted |
| `users` | null or array | no | per-user changes |
| `view_level` | string | no | full or chat_only (not available yet) |

## studio

### `studio_generate`

Profiles: minimal, default, all.

Generate a Studio artifact. Checks the account quota first and returns a QUOTA error when it is used up. Only kind flashcards is available: it needs instructions (the topic) and accepts flashcards.quantity fewer and flashcards.difficulty hard (the defaults; the only options pinned by a live capture). Returns the new artifact as pending; poll studio_list for its status. Other kinds and options return UNSUPPORTED_BY_TRANSPORT after the quota check. Not retried after sending.

Annotations: title: Generate studio artifact, readOnly: false, destructive: false, idempotent: false, openWorld: false.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | string | yes | audio, video, mind_map, report, quiz, flashcards, slide_deck, infographic, data_table or interactive_report |
| `notebook` | string | yes | notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title |
| `flashcards` | null or object | no | options for kind flashcards |
| `instructions` | string | no | focus or style instructions; for flashcards the topic (required) |
| `language` | string | no | output language code (default en) |
| `sources` | null or array | no | source ids, id prefixes or titles; default all sources |

### `studio_list`

Profiles: minimal, default, all.

List a notebook's Studio artifacts (audio, reports, video, ...) with kind and status. Pass artifact to read one with its interactive content (HTML or mind-map tree) when Google has any.

Annotations: title: List studio artifacts, readOnly: true, idempotent: true, openWorld: false.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `notebook` | string | yes | notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title |
| `artifact` | string | no | one artifact id or title; returns it with its interactive content when available |
| `kind` | string | no | filter by kind, for example audio, report, video |
| `status` | string | no | filter by status: pending, ready or failed |
